name: Review: t_p0 rejects explicit 24:00:00
source_basis: SQL Server TIME permits hours 00 through 23. Explicit 24:00 is invalid, distinct from rounding a valid pre-midnight value. Added after inspection of the repair, not a pre-response holdout.
sql: CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.rejects(q text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN EXECUTE q; RETURN false; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN SQLSTATE IN ('22007','22008','23514'); END $$; SELECT pg_temp.rejects($probe$INSERT INTO "TypeSmoke"(s_min,dt2_p0,t_p0) VALUES ('X','2025-01-01','24:00:00')$probe$);
